lines.en: A step, a thud, and moss falls off.
Roots wrap my ankles; I shuffle on.
Wooden joints turn with effort.

lines.zh: 撞开灌木，朝森林深处走。
lines.en: I push through brush toward deep woods.
Stands still, observing surroundings.

lines.en: I stood so long a bird landed on my shoulder.
Sap seeps between my fingers.
Locks eyes on the player.

lines.zh: 我身上的树皮裂开一条缝，盯住你。
lines.en: A crack opens in my bark as I fix on you.
Turns to look for the player.
Looks in the direction of the player.
Scans the player with its eyes.
Carefully observes the player.

lines.en: I stop what I am doing to look at you.
Notices the player.
You hid the axe behind your back.
I know that axe.

lines.zh: 身受重创，森林中的力量在消逝！
lines.en: Torn by wounds, the forest's strength fades!
My roots were cut!
The forest's spirit can't protect me!
My body is decaying...
Wood chips fall from my shoulder.
The forest's soul is leaving me...
My bark is peeling, it hurts!

lines.zh: 森林中的力量已离开我...
lines.en: The forest's power has left me...
I can't fight anymore...
The Tree of Life has abandoned me...
Whispering for companions
Green glow in its eyes

Desire in its eyes

Deep murmurs

Spirit of the forest calls
Magic in the air
Ancient magic flows

Its wooden body is hard
A large wooden mallet

Collides with its wooden form

lines.zh: 它的木制身躯发出嘎吱声。
lines.en: Its wooden body creaks.

lines.zh: 原始森林的回声在其中回荡。
lines.en: The echo of the wildwood resonates within.

lines.zh: 它的巨大木锤敲击声不绝于耳。
lines.en: Its large wooden hammer echoes nonstop.

lines.zh: 它的眼中闪烁着灵魂的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with the light of a soul.
It picks up a piece of magic meat.

lines.zh: 原始森林的呼吸在它周围环绕。
lines.en: The breath of the wildwood surrounds it.

lines.zh: 这根树枝，我要拿回去当手臂。
lines.en: This branch will serve as my new arm.

lines.zh: 它缓缓转动着巨大的木锤。
lines.en: It slowly swings its large wooden hammer.

lines.zh: 它的魔法肉发出微弱的光芒。
lines.en: Its magic meat glows faintly.
It searches for more magic meat.
It targets the prey in the distance.

lines.zh: 它的目光锁定了一只小鹿。
lines.en: Its gaze locks onto a deer.
It slowly approaches the target.

lines.zh: 它的声音在森林中回荡。
lines.en: Its voice echoes through the forest.

lines.zh: 它的眼神中透露出杀气。
lines.en: Its eyes reveal a killing intent.

lines.zh: 它的手臂准备进行攻击。
lines.en: Its arms are ready to attack.
It targets the weakness of its foe.
Its attack is coming.

lines.zh: 它准备用锤子击倒敌人。
lines.en: It prepares to hit its enemy with its hammer.

lines.zh: 它的愤怒让攻击更加猛烈。
lines.en: Its anger makes its attack more fierce.
The smell of an axe—I know it well.

lines.zh: 有人带着锯子进了森林。
lines.en: Someone brought a saw into the wood.
You snapped one of my roots.
The target breathes behind the brush.
It aims at the enemy with its hammer.

lines.zh: 它的目光坚定地锁定目标。
lines.en: Its gaze is firmly locked on the target.
It pounds the ground with its wooden hammer.
Its attack radius has increased.
Its voice is full of threat.
It prepares to release its magic.

lines.zh: 它的攻击方式让人敬畏。
lines.en: Its attack is awe-inspiring.

Its attack is about to be released.

lines.zh: 它的魔法力量即将显现。
lines.en: Its magical power is about to be unleashed.
The mallet rises overhead.
One blow breaks a trunk.

lines.zh: 你退多远，我的根都够得着。
lines.en: However far you back off, my roots reach.
Roots close in at your feet.

lines.zh: 低沉轰鸣声，挥舞木制手臂。
lines.en: Low rumble,挥舞木臂。

lines.zh: 粗大的木槌敲击，震耳欲聋。

lines.zh: 粗壮的手臂挥动，木屑四溅。

lines.en: Rumbling sound, fierce attack.

Rough breathing, angry swings.

At the edge of darkness, a figure appears.
At the tangled roots, a figure emerges.
As night falls, light flickers.
Deep in the forest, light sparkles.

A heap of moss stands up as me.
Vines part, revealing a wooden face.
Birds scatter because I woke.

lines.zh: 被火焰灼烧，森林之魂离我远去！
lines.en: Burned by flames, the forest's spirit leaves me!
I fell and it hurts!

lines.zh: 被水淹没，森林之灵无法拯救！
lines.en: Drowned, the forest's spirit can't save me!

lines.zh: 爆炸冲击波，森林之力破碎！
lines.en: Explosion, the forest's power shattered!

lines.en: Hit by a projectile, the forest's spirit can't protect me!

lines.zh: 被魔法击中，森林之灵无法治愈！

lines.zh: 饿得无法动弹，森林之灵无法助我！
lines.en: Starved to the point of immobility, the forest's spirit can't help me!

lines.zh: 被雷击中，森林之力减弱！

lines.zh: 坠入虚空，森林之魂无法伴随！
